inputs.description: Explicit restart with staged surface/dust/terrain inputs; target.nc is the legacy daily reference

native_contract.clock: MACDA epoch midnight; solver clock=(source_sol+0.5)*rotation_period; orbit anchored to start Ls
native_contract.dust: start coldust held fixed; visible=coldust, longwave=coldust/3
native_contract.initialization: observed spectral T/u/v/log(ps); start-only surface/frost; soil initially uniform oldest history T, insulated bottom, one sol prescribed past surface conduction

manifest.limitation: Prespecified seasonal pilot, not full-coverage held-out climatology

experiment_contract.synthetic_truth_role: prepare-synthetic and gradient checks only; not calibrated controls
limitations: finite-rate CO2 clouds with fixed particle size; fixed gas thermodynamics
prescribed dust; no water cycle or cloud radiation
projected inventory residual is an enforced constraint, not independent conservation
